questions.prompt: A tile of T × T outputs with filter radius R needs how many inputs?
questions.explanation: The tile plus a halo of R on every side.

questions.prompt: Why put the filter in constant memory?
options: All lanes read the same element at once, and the constant cache broadcasts it
It's writable from the host only
questions.explanation: Broadcast reads of a small, read-only array.

questions.prompt: Which are true of tiling a convolution?
options: Global loads per output fall from (2R+1)² to about (T+2R)²/T²
Halo loads are duplicated between neighbouring blocks
It needs a barrier between loading and computing
questions.explanation: DRAM traffic falls only if the cache wasn't already catching the reuse.

questions.prompt: A separable 2R+1 filter costs per output…
options: 2(2R+1) FMAs plus an intermediate image pass
inputs outside the image, given a boundary value
questions.explanation: The boundary policy (zero, clamp, mirror) defines them.
